title: Key Appointments (Tier A — RBI/SEBI/PSU-Bank/major regulator), consolidated Jan-Mar

blocks.content:
| Person | Position | Month |

|---|---|---|

| Sandeep Bakhshi | MD & CEO, ICICI Bank | Jan |

| Hardeep Singh Ahluwalia | MD & CEO, Canara Bank | Jan |

| Arijit Basu | Chairman, IndusInd Bank (replacing Sunil Mehta) | Jan |

| Vinay Muralidhar Tonse | MD & CEO, YES Bank | Feb |

| Multiple Governors (Pratap Shukla-Telangana, Jishnu Dev Varma-Maharashtra, Nand Kishore Yadav-Nagaland, Lt Gen (Retd) Syed Ata Hasnain-Bihar, R.N. Ravi-West Bengal, Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar-Tamil Nadu, Kavinder Gupta-Himachal Pradesh); Vinai Kumar Saxena (LG Ladakh), Taranjit Singh Sandhu (LG Delhi) | Governor reshuffle | Mar |

**Note:** Vinay Muralidhar Tonse's YES Bank MD&CEO appointment was reported in both the Feb and March source batches — listed once above (Feb, first reported month) to avoid duplication.

Brand ambassadors (Mar): Ravindra Jadeja (City Union Bank), Jasprit Bumrah (Uniqlo India), M.S. Dhoni (BHIM Payments App, NBSL/NPCI subsidiary).

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Big-bank leadership cluster spans all three months (ICICI/Canara/IndusInd-Jan; YES/AU/City Union/Fino-Feb; SEBI WTMs/HDFC Bank interim Chair-Mar) — high cross-month confusion risk. Keki Mistry (HDFC Bank) and the SEBI WTM cluster are March's highest-yield picks.
